chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about riding upon the sea during its turbulence.
He said: “Why should a man place his religion in jeopardy?”

key_terms.بِدِينِهِ: with his religion; putting his religious state at risk
key_terms.يُغَرِّرُ: to expose to danger or hazard

ai.seo_question: What did Imām al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about riding the sea during dangerous turbulence?
ai.summary: This hadith records Muḥammad ibn Muslim asking Imām Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about traveling by sea when it is dangerously turbulent. The Imam’s reply discourages exposing oneself to such peril, framing reckless danger as jeopardizing one’s religion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1331 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about traveling by sea when it is turbulent.
He (as) replied: "Why would a person endanger his life and his religion?".
